newsitem.title: ESTONIA: LONG-TERM CALLS DOMINATE OPTIONS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: LONG-TERM CALLS DOMINATE OPTIONS TRADE.

text.p: Hansapank said on Monday that its options trading was steady last week with strong interest in call options.
"Long-term calls were most in demand with the term extending into January 1998 for the first time," Art Lestberg, options trader at Hansapank, told Reuters.
"The main interest is in banking stocks with total options traded during the week at 10-20 million kroons," he added.
Long-term calls for Hansapank were at 210 kroons for 35 kroons and Hoiupank was at 235 kroons for 39 kroons.
Hansapank was quoted today at 208/209 kroons while Hoiu was at 230/232 kroons.
The maturity date for Hansapank's over- the-counter options is the third Friday of each month, with the next maturity on August 16.
